venue.name: Larry Aguilar Pottery Studio
venue.description: Larry Aguilar Pottery Studio is a pottery studio in Qualicum Beach. The studio has no website of its own, so nothing about what it offers, what it costs or when it is open could be confirmed. A phone call is the only way to find out whether it takes children's groups.
